Welcome to Touge Legends: Reborn! 👋
🏁 Race your friends, do time attacks, earn the cars and become ruler of the Mountain Pass!

❗NEW UPDATE!❗

🚗 12 NEW CARS
🔧 EVERY car has been retuned!
🪏 Snow has finally been removed!
☀️ New day and night time lighting!
🩹 April Fools content has been removed!

Please enjoy your stay!
